connection_fields.name: accept_unknown_host
connection_fields.description: trust a host missing from known_hosts

connection_fields.name: private_key_path
connection_fields.description: private key file (instead of a password)

connection_fields.name: private_key
connection_fields.description: the private key's text, e.g. from env_var() (instead of private_key_path)

connection_fields.name: host_key_fingerprint
connection_fields.description: pinned host key, SHA256:... (otherwise ~/.ssh/known_hosts is used)

connection_fields.name: use_agent
connection_fields.description: sign in with the keys in your SSH agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), instead of a password or key file

connection_fields.name: allow_rsa_keys
connection_fields.description: false refuses RSA private keys; true uses them without the RUSTSEC-2023-0071 warning

connection_fields.name: connect_timeout
connection_fields.description: how long to wait for a connection (`30s`, `2m`, or seconds)

connection_fields.name: timeout
connection_fields.description: how long a read or write may make no progress before it fails

connection_fields.name: retries
connection_fields.description: how many times to try again after a temporary error (0: never)

option_fields.name: if_exists
option_fields.description: when a file is already at the path: `overwrite` it, fail with `error`, or `number` the new one

option_fields.name: atomic
option_fields.description: upload under a temporary name, then rename, so no half-written file appears

option_fields.name: temp_dir
option_fields.description: where the temporary file goes (on the same server), for receivers that pick up any new file
